name: RaDiCal benchmark
description: Cohort manifests, result files, analysis and re-derivation scripts, the benchmark ledger, pre-registrations, literature-audit extraction, case VCFs and checksums for a benchmark of one rare-disease variant-interpretation pipeline with a paired no-answer control arm and catalogue ablations. Public and synthetic data only. Not clinically validated; not for diagnostic use. Third-party values inside derived files keep their own licences, listed in README.md; in particular, APOGEE2 (MitImpact) scores remain under MitImpact's non-commercial terms and are not covered by this record's CC BY 4.0 licence.
